name: Vamsadhara

source.name: Eastern Ghats, near Thuamul Rampur, on the Kalahandi-Rayagada district border

sink.name: Near Kalingapatnam
sink.location: Srikakulam district, Andhra Pradesh, Bay of Bengal

did_you_know: The Vamsadhara flows between the Rushikulya and Godavari basins and is shared under a formal water-sharing agreement between Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.
It passes the temple town of Mukhalingam before reaching the Bay of Bengal at Kalingapatnam, both notable heritage sites in Srikakulam district.
